options.html: \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } f } { \partial x \partial z } ( 1 , 0 , 2 ) = 2 \, ;

options.label: B

options.html: \frac { \partial ^ { 2 } f } { \partial x ^ { 2 } } ( 0 , 0 , 1 ) = 0 \; ;

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}=y^{2}+2xz\;,\;\; \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x^{2}}=2z\;,\;\; \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial z}=2x\;,\;\; \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=2xy+z^{2}\;,\;\; \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y\partial z}=2z\;,\;\; \frac{\partial f}{\partial z}=2yz+x^{2}\;,\;\; \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial z^{2}}=2y\;,\cr&\frac{\partial^{3}f}{\partial z^{2}\partial x}=0\;,\;\; \text{所以}\; \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x^{2}}(0,0,1)=2\;,\;\; \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial z}(1,0,2)=2\;,\;\; \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y\partial z}(0,-1,0)=0\;,\;\; \cr&\frac{\partial^{3}f}{\partial z^{2}\partial x}(1,1,1)=0\;.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{x^{2}}\,,\,\,\,\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{y^{2}}\,,\,\,\, \text{则}\, x^{2}\,\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\,\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=2z\,,\,\,\,\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{(1-2x)e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{x^{4}}\,,\\&\\&\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{(1-2y)e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{y^{4}}\,,\,\,\,\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{e^{-(\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y})}}{x^{2}y^{2}}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\cdot \frac{1}{2}\frac{2x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}=\frac{x}{x^{2}+y^{2}}\ ,\ \ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}\cdot \frac{1}{2}\frac{2y}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}=\frac{y}{x^{2}+y^{2}}\ ,\\&\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}-x\cdot 2x}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{2}}=\frac{y^{2}-x^{2}}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{2}}\ ,\ \ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{x^{2}+y^{2}-y\cdot 2y}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{2}}=\frac{x^{2}-y^{2}}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{2}}\ ,\\&\text{则}\ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0\ .\end{aligned}
